jobs.description:
We are hiring! For an international global player in the logistics sector (Puurs / Antwerp region), we are currently looking for a driven 
GL Accountant. Are you ready to perform at Champions League level in a dynamic environment where ownership and change are key?
 
 

•  

Location: Puurs / Antwerp region
  

•  

Company Culture: The bar is set high, but in return, you get a huge amount of freedom and autonomy.
  

•  

Team: You will join the Regional Shared Service Center (RSSC) for Benelux, a team of 30 accountants. The RSSC serves as an internal pilot within the international group: all accounting and controlling activities are centralized and optimized here.
   

Interested? Discover the job details below:
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

•  

End-to-End closing: Taking full responsibility for the timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings from A to Z for your assigned international entities.
  

•  

Financial integrity: Ensuring financial reliability by performing complex balance sheet analyses and in-depth reconciliations.
  

•  

Reporting: Delivering accurate internal and external financial reports on time, in compliance with both local regulations (BE GAAP) and IFRS.
  

•  

Audit & compliance: Serving as the central operational point of contact for both internal and external auditors, and proactively safeguarding internal compliance controls.
  

•  

Process optimization: Actively contributing to the continuous improvement and streamlining of accounting processes within the Regional SSC, and proactively sharing knowledge within the team.
  

•  

Business partnering: Maintaining close internal contacts with the controlling team, which provides support during the closing process and performs deep-dive analyses.
  

Qualifications
 
 

•  

Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
  

•  

Experience: Dynamic accountant with strong experience in General Ledger (GL) accounting, preferably gained in a complex, changing, or international corporate environment.
  

•  

Knowledge & systems:
 
 

•  

In-depth and proven knowledge of BE GAAP and IFRS.
  

•  

Excellent systems knowledge: experience with 
SAP S/4HANA and 
Excel is an absolute must. Knowledge of Power BI is a strong asset.
    

•  

Languages: Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).
  

•  

Essentials:
 
 

•  

Autonomous, proactive, able to structure your own work, and only satisfied when the result is delivered.
  

•  

Resilient, thriving in a dynamic, transforming environment where structures and processes evolve rapidly.
  

•  

Strong, direct, and open communicator regarding what goes well, but also brave enough to discuss mistakes to learn together.

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

Help shape the future of industrial automationAs an Automation Engineer, you take ownership of complex automation projects across Beaulieu International Group. You combine technical expertise with a hands-on approach to improve production assets, strengthen connectivity, and help shape value that lasts. You work across divisions, support sites worldwide, and contribute directly to operational excellence, safety, digitalization, and long-term business success.  Your responsibilities
 
• Take ownership of complex automation projects from concept to implementation, while safeguarding scope, planning, and budget. 
• Evaluate make-or-buy decisions and either develop automation solutions yourself or coordinate external partners. 
• Deliver projects ranging from mid-life upgrades and retrofits to machine integration and the development of new control systems. 
• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, machine safety requirements, cybersecurity standards, and group policies. 
• Drive improvement initiatives that increase output, quality, and efficiency while reducing waste. 
• Coordinate initiatives across divisions and translate best practices into measurable business value. 
• Support data science initiatives through reliable data acquisition and the integration of ICT and MES applications. 
• Execute and coordinate automation tasks and projects related to Operational Technologies, such as industrial networks, camera vision, integration of ICT/MES systems. 
• Support the divisions with technical expertise in digital diagnostics. 

Your profile
 
• You hold a Master's degree in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field. 
• You have at least 5 year's experience with industrial automation and operational technology environments. 
• You work hands-on and take ownership of technical challenges from analysis to implementation. 
• You have a working knowledge of Siemens TIA Portal, E-plan, industrial networks, machine safety standards, frequency converters, and drivetrains. 
• You are eager to learn and continuously expand your expertise in safety, OT cybersecurity, automation, and data connectivity. 
• You communicate effectively in English and Dutch or French.

Are you a dedicated CE truck driver with a passion for the construction industry? As a concrete mixer driver, you’ll deliver fresh concrete daily to various sites in the Antwerp and Brussels areas. You’ll operate a modern fleet and receive clear routes and delivery plans from central dispatch. Your main job is to safely load concrete at our production sites and deliver it on time to different construction locations. You’ll be the face of the company, ensuring proper handover of documents, communicating effectively with customers, and following specific guidelines for each delivery.

On a typical workday, you’ll start at one of our state-of-the-art production sites in Sint-Katelijne-Waver or Hemiksem. After loading your mixer, you’ll follow your designated route to the client, where you’ll deliver the concrete. Your day will include several trips within urban areas, sometimes with restricted access. In these cases, you’ll get extra instructions and support from dispatch. In between, you’ll make sure all transport documents are completed accurately and thoroughly. You work independently but can always rely on an experienced team for support.

Do you see yourself working in a well-organized company with a strong focus on quality and safety? Do you want to be part of a growing family business and enjoy competitive pay, extra benefits, and the possibility of a permanent contract? Apply today and become the driving force behind our concrete mixers!

• You have a valid CE driver’s license and a valid driver card

• You have experience as a CE driver, preferably with completing transport documents

• You speak and understand communicative English

• You are physically fit and motivated to work hands-on

• You are resilient and can confidently navigate complex routes, including urban settings

• You work accurately and appreciate clear agreements

• You’re willing to work a flexible schedule (including overtime possible)

• In credit risk model analysis and maintainance

• Sustainability & Circular Economy: De Beleyr actively promotes eco-friendly manufacturing. By extending component lifecycles through precise repairs and thermal coatings, clients achieve an average 85% reduction in  emissions and up to 75% cost savings compared to purchasing new OEM parts. All machining scraps and metal powders are 100% recycled.
• In-House Quality Control: Equipped with a dedicated measuring room, advanced measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, precision gauges), and technical design software to validate tight tolerances for every single workpiece.
• Flexible & Custom Production: No monotone series production. The workshop processes single pieces, complex custom builds, and small repair batches ranging from intricate miniature components to massive industrial shafts.
Driven by a team of skilled machining specialists and continuous investment in automation and state-of-the-art machinery, De Beleyr Engineering guarantees high delivery reliability, short lead times, and top-tier craftsmanship.

 Required Experience:

• Practical experience with conventional cylindrical grinding is essential.
• Experience with manually setting up conventional cylindrical grinding machines independently.
• Experience with aligning and clamping workpieces correctly on the machine.
• Experience in performing measurements independently using accurate measuring tools, including micrometers.
• Experience working with high precision on a micrometer level.
• Experience reading and interpreting technical plans and mechanical drawings.
• Experience working with hard materials.
• Preferred experience with machine brands: Norton, TOS, and Danobat.
• Preferred experience or familiarity with diamond grinding wheels.
 Education & Qualifications:

• TSO level or equivalent.
• Technical education in areas such as:
• Metalworking 
• Machining 
• Mechanical Design / Shaping 
• Mechanical Engineering 
• Mechanical Techniques 
Note: Relevant practical experience is just as important as a diploma. Proven hands-on experience and technical insight carry more weight than formal qualifications.

 Competencies & Profile:

• Strong technical understanding and a good feel for machines and how workpieces react during grinding.
• Ability to work with high accuracy, control, and patience to bring workpieces step-by-step to the exact size.
• Strong focus on quality, preferring to deliver one perfect part over five parts that require subsequent rework.
• Solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and solve problems independently.
• Capable of working both independently with high autonomy and as part of a team.
• Driven, eager to learn, and stress resistant.
• Positive attitude, neat and safe working habits, and willing to get hands dirty.
• Professional and courteous appearance
• Willingness to be flexible regarding working hours/overtime when required.
• Language Requirements: Proficiency in English or German (Dutch is not mandatory).

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Intern – B2B Food Supplements
jobs.description:
Who we areFermedics is a Ghent-based scale-up making fermented botanical ingredients for food supplement brands. And we’re growing fast: in recent years we’ve roughly doubled every year. We’re riding two big waves at once, a booming supplements market and the fermentation trend. Small team, big ambitions, short communication lines. 
Your missionHelp us build a real digital marketing strategy. The basics are already there: our website, LinkedIn, Semrush for SEO/GEO analysis, newsletters and Canva. Now we need someone to bring it all together, including a content plan for our newsletter, Instagram and LinkedIn communication. 
What you’ll be doing
 
 

• SEO & GEO: dig into Semrush, spot the gaps and fix them, so both Google and LLM models like Claude & ChatGPT find us 

• Sales funnel & Campaigns: map out our funnel and set up campaigns across channels and drive conversions 

• Website: improve findability, structure and conversion 

• Content: social posts, blog posts, mailings and website copy 

• Instagram: yes, B2B. Our customers (supplement brands) are there, so we should be too. You’ll launch and grow our account 

• Influencers: get relevant influencers on board to boost our reach and visibility 

• Showcasing finished products: plan how we highlight products made with our ingredients across the website, LinkedIn and Instagram 

• Visuals: create eye-catching marketing material 
 

• A student or recent graduate in (digital) marketing, communication or a related field 

• Digital native: you know social media, content and SEO, and you’re curious about AI search 

• Strong writer in English (Dutch is a plus) 

• Creative, hands-on and independent; you like to own your projects 

• Interested in health, food (supplements) or science? Then you’ll like it here!

Are you an experienced .NET DevOps Engineer with strong skills in ASP.NET Core and Azure DevOps pipelines ?

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET DevOps Engineer to join a dynamic platform team working in a large-scale Agile IT environment.

The team works transversally across the organization and focuses on making the Azure Cloud platform accessible, scalable and easy to use for other development teams. You will work in a multidisciplinary team following Agile, Scrum and SAFe methodologies.
Role
• Design, develop and maintain reusable .NET components using C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Design, develop and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD components using C#, PowerShell, YAML pipelines and Bicep.
• Collaborate with developers, testers, architects, Product Owners and Scrum Masters in a SAFe environment.
• Participate in PI Planning and other Agile ceremonies.
• Analyze and resolve technical issues and bugs.
• Perform code reviews and ensure high-quality code through unit and integration testing.
• Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing.
• Provide technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to less experienced colleagues.
• Continuously improve development processes, software quality and technical solutions.
• Stay up to date with relevant technologies and industry best practices.
Profile
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role.
• Strong experience with .NET, C# and ASP.NET Core.
• Solid experience with Azure DevOps and Azure Cloud.
• Experience with CI/CD, YAML pipelines, PowerShell and Bicep.
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Strong technical coaching and mentoring abilities.
• Adaptability and a continuous learning mindset
 
Nice to Have
At least 1 year of experience with:

• WCF
• Blazor
• gRPC
• GitHub EnterpriseLanguages
• Dutch or French: Native level
• Second national language (Dutch or French): Basic written and spoken communication
• English: Good comprehension.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you?

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?
 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.
